selectionGuide.description: Four stages of applying clown makeup turn a chain of worsening choices or beliefs into a visible loss of credibility.
bestFor: a sequence of increasingly bad decisions
rationalizations that deepen into obvious self-deception
an escalating commitment whose final stage is plainly absurd
avoidWhen: there is only one mistake with no progression
the steps cannot be ordered from questionable to worse
the joke would punch down at a vulnerable person rather than critique choices

mechanics.visual: Each panel adds more clown makeup, visually mapping continued commitment to a progressively less credible position.
mechanics.text: Fill step1 through step4 with linked choices or claims in worsening order, using consistent phrasing and the clearest clown moment last.
